t.zh: <part-ref to="resizeLinear"></part-ref>只沿一行插值，竖直方向照抄离得最近的那一行。放大一张二维的图，新像素在上下方向也落在两行之间。这一关的问题是：在二维图像里，落在四个旧像素中间的新像素，值怎么算？
t.en: The <part-ref to="resizeLinear"></part-ref> interpolates only along a row and copies the nearest row vertically. Enlarging a 2D image, a new pixel also falls between two rows. This level asks: in a 2D image, how is the value of a new pixel among four old ones computed?

t.zh: 两个任务：先用手上的线性缩放只改一张图的宽度，看它在每一行上做了什么；再升级这个元件，让新像素的值由周围四个旧像素决定。升级后的元件要通过二维放大和缩小的测试。
t.en: Two tasks: first use the linear resizer in hand to change only an image's width and see what it does on each row; then upgrade the part so a new pixel's value comes from the four old pixels around it. The upgraded part must pass tests that enlarge and shrink in two dimensions.

desc.zh: 输入一张图和新的宽 w、高 h，输出缩放后的图：每个新像素由周围四个旧像素按距离加权（双线性）
desc.en: Takes an image and a new width w and height h; gives the resized image, each new pixel weighted from the four old pixels around it by distance (bilinear)

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>：新值是四个邻居的加权平均，比最近邻平滑；OpenCV 里叫 INTER_LINEAR。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>: the new value a weighted average of four neighbours, smoother than nearest neighbour; OpenCV calls it INTER_LINEAR.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和新的宽：交出只改了宽度、高度不变的图。
brief.en: Given an image and a new width, give the image with only its width changed, its height as it was.

after.zh: 每一行各自沿 x 插值，行和行之间没有混合。
after.en: Each row is interpolated along x on its own; rows are never mixed.

brief.zh: 升级线性缩放：输入一张图和新的宽、高，新像素由周围四个旧像素按距离加权。
brief.en: Upgrade the linear resize: given an image and a new width and height, each new pixel weighted from the four old pixels around it by distance.

hint.zh: 竖直方向也有一个距离：新位置离上面那一行有多远。
hint.en: There is a vertical distance too: how far the new position is from the row above.

hint.zh: 上下两行各沿 x 插一次，得到两个值，再在它们之间沿 y 插一次。
hint.en: Interpolate along x on the row above and on the row below, then along y between the two results.
